Rooms.Name: Demonic Entrance
Rooms.Description:
Here is the entrance to the Demon Empire. A large tunnel, heading 
south into the unknown. Bones and skulls litter the floor, and a 
fierce smell haunts this cave. There is a small sign hanging from the 
neck of a skeleton.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: #RWelcome Mortals!#N

Rooms.Name: Guard Station
Rooms.Description:
This is the guard station that borders to the world of the pity 
mortals. This is their first line of defence, not usually very well 
defended since demons are quite vain. Who could possibly harm them?
North of here is the exit, and south...lies evil.

Rooms.Name: The Way Down
Rooms.Description:
This might be your last chance of getting out of here. In here, is 
a large and very slippery stairway going down. Somewhere below you,
you can hear a gong chime, often followed by terrifying screams and a 
huge roar that sends shivers down your spine.

Rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through. Here are the stairs up, but there is no chance of 
getting up that way. A complex forcefield bars the way up.
#GA bag full with diamonds.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large black bag, full with glittering stones...but...it is somewhat 
transparent.

Rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA dagger surrounded by darkness.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A common looking dagger seems to attract darkness...but...it isn't 
quite as solid as it seems to be.

Rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA key made of a huge tooth lies here.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A key made of an old tooth...but...you can see straight through it.

Rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA key covered with hot flames.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small key which burns with a hot flame...but...as you try to take it,
your hand can't touch it.

Rooms.Name: Well Of Cries
Rooms.Description:
Here is a small well made of skulls. Wailing cries flow up from the 
well, filling you with fear and anguish. There's a large door to the 
south, seemingly made of mirrors. Thousands of small mirrors.

Rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.

Rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items

slides through.
#GA bloodied axe lies here.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large and very bloody axe lies here...but...it keeps on fading in 
and out of view, all the time.

Rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#YThe gatekeeper stands here, watching you.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The gatekeeper is a truly astonishing creature. It's a shame it isn't 
here for real. Just an illusion...

Rooms.Name: Circle Of Illusions
Rooms.Description:
This hall is strange...Monsters show up just to fade away. Items 
litter the floor, but as you try to pick something up your hand just 
slides through.
#GA bowl filled with a disgusting looking fluid lies here.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A black bowl, filled with a fluid full of what seems to be dead 
insects...Lucky you it is nothing but an illusion.

Rooms.Name: Bottom Of The Well
Rooms.Description:
Here, screams and sounds of crying bombard you from the south. You 
immediately think of leaving, but is efficiantly stopped by a 
forcefield. Even without the forcefield, it would have been difficult 
to get up. Chains and empty shackles hang from the red walls. There's
a path going south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Empty chains and shackles, dangle from the walls. In some of the 
shackles, bits and pieces of fur and skin can be seen.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Tears
Rooms.Description:
In here, the prisoners are kept chained to the walls. Humans,
elves, dwarves...all kinds of races fill these halls, awaiting
torture and eventually death. Cries of help are shouted at you as
hope fills their eyes, just to fade again as you try to break the
chains, but fail. To the north and the south the path goes on.

Rooms.Name: Guard Post
Rooms.Description:
This guard post is here for the single purpose of fright. Scare the 
prisoners and they won't give you any trouble. Corpses and skeletons 
litter the floor, obviously killed for the pleasure of frightening the 
living. A large bonfire burns in here and judging by the smell of it, 
they are using bodies as fuel. There's a path going both east and west 
from here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large bonfire, burning the corpses no longer needed by the demons, 
produces a fierce smell.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Tears
Rooms.Description:

their eyes, just to fade again as you try to break the chains, but
fail. There's a guard post to the west, and the path goes on to the
north and to the south.

elves, dwarves...all kinds of races fill these halls, awaiting torture
and eventually death. Cries of help are shouted at you as hope fills
their eyes, just to fade again as you try to break the chains, but
fail. There's a large chamber to the east, and the path can be seen 
going on to the south.

Rooms.Name: Chamber Of Torments
Rooms.Description:
In this room there are several large instruments of pain, some
which you recognize and some which you don't. Several Iron maidens 
line the walls, which all are occupied. A stretching rack has been
placed in the middle of the room, with the remains of a now very tall
dwarf lying upon it. On a large shelf, you can see several tools for
hurting. Wicked looking knives, thongs, whips. Above you is a large
trapdoor.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Tears
Rooms.Description:
In here, the prisoners are kept chained to the walls. Humans, 
elves, dwarves...all kinds of races fill these halls, awaiting torture
and eventually death. Cries of help are shouted at you as hope fills
their eyes, just to fade again as you try to break the chains, but
fail. To the south lies a large room, while the path continues to the 
north.

Rooms.Name: Mirror Of Mists
Rooms.Description:
This room is completely empty except for one thing - A huge pool 
with a surface like a mirror. Within it there's movement. A greyish 
mist swirling around and around, sometimes forming a face contorted
by pain. Other times forming a huge fist, trying to break the surface.
A path goes to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Other Side
Rooms.Description:
You are in a chamber with a very high ceiling. The roof seems to be
a mirror. No dimensional gateway. Just a common mirror. You won't be 
able to leave through here. To the south, you see a large hall glowing 
with a sickly red color.

Rooms.Name: Northwest Part Of Bloodhall
Rooms.Description:
This is the northwestern part of the huge hall. The walls here are 
drenched with a thick red fluid - Blood!
You are now in the domain of the vicious Bloodthirster. This is the 
home of that foul demon.

Rooms.Name: North Part Of Bloodhall
Rooms.Description:
The northern part of the huge hall. On the floor, a trickle of blood 
seems to flow towards the centre of the hall. Other than that, the 
floor is absolutely clean. To the south, you can see a huge fountain 
showering the surrounding area with a red fluid. To the north, there 
is a large chamber.

Rooms.Name: Northeast Part Of Bloodhall
Rooms.Description:
This is the northeastern part of the huge hall. The walls here are 
drenched with a thick red fluid - Blood!
You are now in the domain of the vicious Bloodthirster. This is the 
home of that foul demon.

Rooms.Name: Eternal Gateway
Rooms.Description:
Here the walls are made of white marble, seeming out of place in 
this otherwise cruel empire. In the middle of the room, there's a 
pool with a face frozen within it. A face full of absolute obedience.
To the east lies the bloodhall.

Rooms.Name: West Part Of Bloodhall
Rooms.Description:
The Western part of the huge hall. On the floor, a trickle of blood 
seems to flow towards the centre of the hall. Other than that, the 
floor is absolutely clean. To the east, you can see a huge fountain 
showering the surrounding area with a red fluid. To the west, you see 
a large white room.

Rooms.Name: Fountain Of Blood
Rooms.Description:
A huge fountain, showering the area and you with a thick red fluid.
The fountain seems to be made of white marble, which combined with 
the red fluid, gives away an eerie feeling. Several jugs are placed
beside the fountain, all filled with the fluid. This is the favourite 
hiding place of the demonic Bloodthirster.

Rooms.Name: East Part Of Bloodhall
Rooms.Description:
The eastern part of the huge hall. On the floor, a trickle of blood 
seems to flow towards the centre of the hall. Other than that, the 
floor is absolutely clean. To the west, you can see a huge fountain 
showering the surrounding area with a red fluid. To the east you see a 
large white room.

this otherwise cruel empire. In the middle of the room, there's a pool

drenched with a thick red fluid - Blood!

Rooms.Name: South Part Of Bloodhall
Rooms.Description:
The southern part of the huge hall. On the floor, a trickle of blood 
seems to flow towards the centre of the hall. Other than that, the 
floor is absolutely clean. To the north, you can see a huge fountain 
showering the surrounding area with a red fluid. To the south you can 
see blood gathering.

Rooms.Name: Southeast Part Of Bloodhall
Rooms.Description:
This is the southeastern part of the huge hall. The walls here are 
drenched with a thick red fluid - Blood!
You are now in the domain of the vicious Bloodthirster. This is the 
home of that foul demon.

Rooms.Name: Bloodgate
Rooms.Description:
Here a pool of blood has been created by the fountain. The walls are 
red with blood, and the smell is quite disgusting. A small whirlpool 
swirls around in the blood. Seems like there's something at the bottom.
To the north lies the bloodhall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pool of blood, created by the constant flow from the fountain. It 
seems to be something at the bottom of the pool...Maybe a drainage 
system?

Rooms.Name: Eternal Gateway
Rooms.Description:
This room is completely bare except for a large pool in the middle
of the room. In the pool, you can see a huge open hand, gently 
sheltering your reflections. Cries and shouts come from the south, 
full of pain and fear.

Rooms.Name: Eternal Gateway
Rooms.Description:
This room is completely bare except for a large pool in the middle 
of the room. In the pool, you can see a huge open hand, gently 
sheltering your reflections. From the south cries and shouts, filled 
with death, come over and over again.

Rooms.Name: Row Of Eternal Damnation
Rooms.Description:
In this long hall, you see hundreds of victims of the demons. All 
are chained to the bright white walls, screaming in utter terror as 
they relive the memories of the tormentor, over and over again. Over
the cries, you hear a faint howling sound. The row continues to the
east and the west. To the north is the gateway.

Rooms.Name: Row Of Eternal Damnation
Rooms.Description:
In this long hall, you see hundreds of victims of the demons. All 
are chained to the bright white walls, screaming in utter terror as
they relive the memories of the tormentor, over and over again. Over
the cries, you hear a faint howling sound. The row continues to the
east and the west.

Rooms.Name: Row Of Eternal Death
Rooms.Description:
In this long hall, you see hundreds of victims of the demons. 
Strangely enough no one is chained or shackled, but then you 
understand why. Every single being in here, is reliving their
fears and thoughts just before they died...then they die again,
again and again. The hall continues to the east and the west.

Rooms.Name: Row Of Eternal Death
Rooms.Description:
In this long hall, you see hundreds of victims of the demons. 
Strangely enough no one is chained or shackled, but then you 
understand why. Every single being in here, is reliving their
fears and thoughts just before they died...then they die again,
again and again. The hall continues to the east and the west,
and to the north is the eternal gateway.

Rooms.Name: Row Of Eternal Death
Rooms.Description:
In this long hall, you see hundreds of victims of the demons. 
Strangely enough no one is chained or shackled, but then you 
understand why. Every single being in here, is reliving their
fears and thoughts just before they died...then they die again,
again and again. The hall continues to the east and the west.

Rooms.Name: Bleeding Room
Rooms.Description:
This room has walls that seem to bleed, as the blood from above 
flows down. It is quite a bizarre effect. In here there's a throne made
of bones, now quite red. The throne is...huge. This is the chamber of 
the mighty Crimson Lord. In a corner, some maps have been thrown. Some
of them are stuck beneath the throne. Above you is the bloody gate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some maps that have been thown in a corner. At closer examination, you 
notice that some are maps over Midgaard. Several maps show locations 
you know! A few maps seem to be stuck beneath the throne.

A large throne made of bones, now colored red by the everflowing blood.
The throne hasn't been placed straight, but on the other hand, it IS 
demons we are dealing with at the moment.

Rooms.Name: Guard Post
Rooms.Description:
Another guard post. This is the entrance to the Dethguard barracks. 
Torches illumine the area, spreading a ghastly light upon adventurers 
and victims, not as lucky as you. Bones and corpses can be seen 
everywhere. Here is a ladder going up, and to the south lies the 
barracks, a large black building placed within this cave.

Rooms.Name: Northwest Part Of The Barracks
Rooms.Description:
The barracks is the place where the dethguards rest, train and enjoy 
the fears of some poor victims. Large and sturdy chairs are placed 
along the walls. Along the walls, racks for weapons and armors can be 
found. To the north is the exit, and the barracks continue to the east 
and the south.

Rooms.Name: Northeast Part of The Barracks
Rooms.Description:
The barracks is the place where the dethguards rest, train and enjoy 
the fears of some poor victims. Large and sturdy chairs are placed 
along the walls. Along the walls, racks for weapons and armors can be 
found. The barracks continue to the west and the south.

Rooms.Name: Southwest Part Of The Barracks
Rooms.Description:
The barracks is the place where the dethguards rest, train and enjoy 
the fears of some poor victims. Large and sturdy chairs are placed 
along the walls. Along the walls, racks for weapons and armors can be 
found. The barracks continue to the east and the north.

Rooms.Name: Southeast Part Of The Barracks
Rooms.Description:
The barracks is the place where the dethguards rest, train and enjoy 
the fears of some poor victims. Large and sturdy chairs are placed 
along the walls. Along the walls, racks for weapons and armors can be 
found. The barracks continue to the west and the north, and to the 
south you can see a guard post.

Rooms.Name: Guard Post
Rooms.Description:
For once you enter a small room...a really small room. All there is 
in here, is a ladder going both up and down. From below, bright light 
shoots up through the hole in the floor. From above comes a faint 
disgusting smell, and a greenish fluid flows down the walls. To the 
north lies the barracks.

Rooms.Name: Tunnel Of Slime
Rooms.Description:
Here in this small passage there is almost no room to move, and it 
is slippery. A greenish kind of thick slime flows down from above. In 
here it smells, no, it stinks. You can use the ladder to get either up 
or down.

Rooms.Name: Slimy Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are now by a large gate with the doors hanging from their 
hinges. Death and decay seems to live within these halls. In the middle
of the floor, a stream of green slime flow from the north and down by
the ladder. There's garbage all over the chamber, and the smell...

Rooms.Name: Dirty Path
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path full of dirt and filth. A stream of green slime 
flows from the north to the south. It really stinks in here. Some 
fresh air would be nice. To the south is the entrance, and to the 
north the hall continues.

Rooms.Name: Dirty Path
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path full of dirt and filth. A stream of green slime 
flows from the north to the south. It really stinks in here. Some 
fresh air would be nice. The hall continues to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: Plague Farm
Rooms.Description:
This room is full of decaying bodies with thousands of flies 
circling them. In here, plagues will be created and spread all over the
world by the flies. The walls here are black with flies, and so is the
roof. Each time you set down your foot, a sickening sound reaches your
ears as you crush hundreds of flies. The exit is to the east.

Rooms.Name: Disgusting Path
Rooms.Description:
Here the once only dirty path, become most disgusting. Here the 
stream of green slime has become bigger. Even the smell is worse than
it was before. To the east and to the west, there are chambers. The 
hall continues to the north and to the south.

Rooms.Name: Plague Farm
Rooms.Description:
This room is full of decaying bodies with thousands of flies 
circling them. In here, plagues will be created and spread all over the
world by the flies. The walls here are black with flies, and so is the
roof. Each time you set down your foot, a sickening sound reaches your
ears as you crush hundreds of flies. The exit is to the west.

Rooms.Name: Repulsive Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are now by a huge gate in this repulsive hall. Beneath the gate, 
several small trickles of green slime flow just to become a larger 
stream. Whatever is causing this stream, and that fierce smell, can be 
found beyond these doors. The hall continues to the south.

Rooms.Name: Cave Of Filth
Rooms.Description:
This is quite a repulsive chamber. The air is so bad, you hardly can 
breathe. Garbage and decaying bodies are all over the place. You now 
see that the river of slime comes from the east. To the north, east 
and west you can see piles of garbage. To the south, you only see 
garbage.

Rooms.Name: Mirror Entrance
Rooms.Description:
This room is blindingly bright. Lightning seems to fly across the 
room and through you, just to reflect in a mirror and come back again. 
Mirrors...All walls, the roof and even the floor, are made of mirrors. 
Something's wrong with the eastern mirrorwall. There's a ladder going 
up here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mirror on the eastern wall looks strange. It looks like lightning 
has been trapped within it. While the other mirrors just bounce it 
between eachother, the eastern mirror has captured a streak of 
lightning. Even your own reflection looks strange in it. No sharp 
edges at all.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Reflections
Rooms.Description:
Mirrors all over the room. Where ever you look, you see a reflection 
of yourself. But not any reflection. You see your most sacred secrets, 
fears and feelings being reflected back to you. Your mind feels heavy. 
To the south, the path continues.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Reflections
Rooms.Description:
Mirrors all over the room. Where ever you look, you see a reflection 
of yourself. But not any reflection. You see your most sacred secrets, 
fears and feelings being reflected back to you. Your mind feels heavy. 
The path goes on to the north and the east.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Reflections
Rooms.Description:
Mirrors all over the room. Where ever you look, you see a reflection 
of yourself. But not any reflection. You see your most sacred secrets, 
fears and feelings being reflected back to you. Your mind feels heavy. 
The Path continues to the south and the west.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Reflections
Rooms.Description:
Mirrors all over the room. Where ever you look, you see a reflection 
of yourself. But not any reflection. You see your most sacred secrets, 
fears and feelings being reflected back to you. Your mind feels heavy. 
To the north and the east, the path continues.

Rooms.Description:
Mirrors all over the room. Where ever you look, you see a reflection 
of yourself. But not any reflection. You see your most sacred secrets, 
fears and feelings being reflected back to you. Your mind feels heavy. 
The path goes on to the east and the west.

Rooms.Name: Guard Post
Rooms.Description:
Here a small guard post has been erected. Propably to defend the 
inner keep - The Emperor's domain. A few mirrors are placed on the 
walls. Two doors can be found in this chamber. One small, almost tiny
door to the east. Another much larger door, can be found to the south.
You feel strange.

Rooms.Name: Chamber Of Darkness
Rooms.Description:
It certainly is dark in here. That's all there is - Darkness. And it 
is quiet, very quiet. You begin to feel those childhood fears start to 
come back again. The small door, is to the west.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Broken Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
In this hall, all the mirrors have been destroyed. The floor, the
roof, everything. Pieces of the mirrors lie everywhere, forcing you to
watch extra carefully where you step. There's a door to the north. The
hall goes on to the south.

Rooms.Name: Path Of Broken Mirrors
Rooms.Description:
In this hall, all the mirrors have been destroyed. The floor, the
roof, everything. Pieces of the mirrors lie everywhere, forcing you to
watch extra carefully where you step. The path goes on to the north
and east. From the east, terrifying screams can be heard occasionally.

Rooms.Name: Temple Of Sacrifice
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a large temple, dedicated to the emperor. People 
sit huddled by the walls, trembling with fear. In the middle of the 
temple, an altar has been placed. It's extremely bloody on and around 
the altar. There's a deep pit in the northeastern corner of the temple.
In a pool by the eastern wall, a energy vortex can be found. A path 
goes to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A crude altar, covered with blood. Here is where the demonic Dark 
reaper performs the sacrifices dedicated to the emperor. Some runes 
have been carved into the altar, but you fail to decipher them.

A very deep pit, with hundreds of bodies in it. This is where they 
throw the bodies after the sacrifices are done. Some of the bodies 
move...There must be someone still alive down there.

Rooms.Name: Guard Post
Rooms.Description:
There's a magnificent looking guard post here. Gold, silver and 
jewels can be seen everywhere. The walls seem to be made of white
marble, with a script of black marble. The script tells of the emperor
and his glory and might. The only exit lies to the east.

Rooms.Name: Hotter Than Hell
Rooms.Description:
This chamber is really hot. Fires burn everywhere. Huge torches line 
the walls, and a river of molten magma flows through here. Not a very 
big river, but still quite impressive. There's also a large pile of 
what seems to be ashes. In the floor, you see a large trapdoor made
of some kind of heat resistant metal.

Rooms.Name: Hall Of Trophies
Rooms.Description:
This hall is impressive. The walls are brightly white marble. High
pillars line the walls. Small pedestals are placed as well, along the
walls. On the pedestals, petrified items have been placed. Even some
ancient elven and human kings have been petrified. It's really warm in
here. Above you is a trapdoor, and the hall continues to the east and
the south.

Rooms.Name: Hall Of Trophies
Rooms.Description:
This hall is impressive. The walls are brightly white marble. High 
pillars line the walls. Small pedestals are placed as well, along the 
walls. On the pedestals, petrified items have been placed. Even some 
ancient elven and human kings have been petrified. The hall goes on to 
the west and to the east.

Rooms.Name: Entrance To The Dead
Rooms.Description:
This hall is impressive. The walls are brightly white marble. High 
pillars line the walls. Small pedestals are placed as well, along the
walls. On the pedestals, petrified items have been placed. Even some 
ancient elven and human kings have been petrified. In the south wall, 
a really strange door can be found. It seems to be made of a huge 
skull, taken from some long dead beast. The hall continues to the east 
and the west.

Rooms.Name: Hall Of Trophies
Rooms.Description:
This hall is impressive. The walls are brightly white marble. High 
pillars line the walls. Small pedestals are placed as well, along the 
walls. On the pedestals, petrified items have been placed. Even some 
ancient elven and human kings have been petrified. To the east and the 
west, the hall continues.

Rooms.Name: Gilded Stairway
Rooms.Description:
Here a magnificent gilded stairway dominates the room. Several large 
rubys and emeralds can be seen in it. This is a stairway worthy of an 
Emperor...a mighty Emperor. There's a large and sturdy chair by the 
stairs. A hall goes on to the west and the south.

Rooms.Name: Hall Of Trophies
Rooms.Description:
This hall is impressive. The walls are brightly white marble. High 
pillars line the walls. Small pedestals are placed as well, along the 
walls. On the pedestals, petrified items have been placed. Even some 
ancient elven and human kings have been petrified. The hall continues 
to the north and to the south.

Rooms.Name: Skull Chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are inside a huge skull of a long dead beast. It is very dark 
and damp in here. And very silent. Not a sound can be heard. To the 
north, you can exit through the mouth. Here is also a ladder going 
down, where the throat of the beast would be.

Rooms.Name: Hall Of Trophies
Rooms.Description:
This hall is impressive. The walls are brightly white marble. High 
pillars line the walls. Small pedestals are placed as well, along the 
walls. On the pedestals, petrified items have been placed. Even some 
ancient elven and human kings have been petrified. To the north and 
the south you can see the hall go on.

Rooms.Name: Hall Of Trophies
Rooms.Description:
This hall is impressive. The walls are brightly white marble. High 
pillars line the walls. Small pedestals are placed as well, along the 
walls. On the pedestals, petrified items have been placed. Even some 
ancient elven and human kings have been petrified. To the south,
there's a tiny black door. To the west there's a guard post, and the
hall continues to the north.

Rooms.Name: Hall Of Trophies
Rooms.Description:
This hall is impressive. The walls are brightly white marble. High 
pillars line the walls. Small pedestals are placed as well, along the 
walls. On the pedestals, petrified items have been placed. Even some 
ancient elven and human kings have been petrified. The hall goes on 
both north and south.

Rooms.Name: Soulhunter Pavillion
Rooms.Description:
This is a very dark part of this empire. Howling sounds can be heard 
constantly, leaving an eerie feeling. These are the chambers of the 
soulhunters. Those who travel in the worlds of the mortals, just to 
capture the living and especially their souls. Several hooks line the 
walls, where they hang their soul bags when not needed. They are all 
empty at the moment. To the north is the exit, and the pavillion 
continues to the east.

Rooms.Name: Soulhunter Pavillion
Rooms.Description:
This is a very dark part of this empire. Howling sounds can be heard 
constantly, leaving an eerie feeling. These are the chambers of the 
soulhunters. Those who travel in the worlds of the mortals, just to 
capture the living and especially their souls. Several hooks line the 
walls, where they hang their soul bags when not needed. They are all 
empty at the moment. The pavillion goes on both to the east and to
the west.

Rooms.Name: Guard Post
Rooms.Description:
Here a guard post has been erected. It is obvious they put it here
to protect the large metal door on the eastern wall. There has to be 
something valuable to them behind those doors. You see some small 
jewels and a few gold coins lying scattered all over the floor. Maybe 
they are protectiong their treasury? The way out lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: Treasury
Rooms.Description:
A huge pile of gold and jewellry is the first you notice as you 
enter this chamber. Valuables lie in heaps all around the pile. Then
you notice the darkness around you. It is quite thick, and not a sound
can be heard. Maybe the guard post outside, was meant for keeping 
something in as well as keeping intruders out? The exit is through the 
large door to the west.

Rooms.Name: Silvery Stairway
Rooms.Description:
A small, almost tiny stairway, made of the purest of silver rises 
majesticaly up to the next floor. The stairway is full of small gems, 
sparkling with light. This is a stairway, made for an emperess of 
great strength and might. The hall goes on to the north.

Rooms.Name: Tormentor's Sanctum
Rooms.Description:
This is the most sacred chamber of the head tormentor, the guardian
of pain. This is where she keeps the tools, the sufferings, the
memories of the victims that brought some joy into her life. Tools
meant for torture, lie neatly stashed upon the shelves among jars and
trophies. Beneath you, is a large and sturdy trapdoor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jars and trophies kept by the head tormentor as memories of her most 
entertaining guests. In one jar you see some teeth, while another 
holds three fingers. Morbid items can be seen everywhere.

Rooms.Name: Row Of Eternal Damnation
Rooms.Description:
In this long hall, you see hundreds of victims of the demons. All 
are chained to the bright white walls, screaming in utter terror as
they relive the memories of the tormentor, over and over again. Over
the cries, you hear a faint howling sound. The row goes on to the east 
and the west.

Rooms.Name: Emperor's Sanctum
Rooms.Description:
This chamber is magnificent. The walls glow with inbound magic, 
showering the chamber with a mystical kind of light. This chamber is 
empty except for a huge throne against the east wall. The throne is...
There are no words to describe it. It is great as it glows and
glitters in the spooky light. This truly is a chamber fit for an
Emperor. The only exit is down the gilded stairway.

Rooms.Name: Empress Study
Rooms.Description:
This chamber is huge and the first thing that comes to your mind, is 
how much it resembles a temple. A large pentagram has been painted 
with red color on the north wall, and a small altar has been placed in 
front of it. As you get closer to the altar, the pentagram begins to 
glow, washing you with a soft light. This is a chamber for dark and
powerful magic. Down the silvery stairway is the only exit.

Rooms.Name: Mirror of mists
Rooms.Description:
This is a very small room, with only one thing in it - A mirror. The 
mirror is placed against the north wall. Powerful magic has been 
worked here. The mirror is a portal, but it has been warded against 
uninvited visitors. The only exit, lies to the south.

Rooms.Name: Spawning room
Rooms.Description:
This is a pretty small room. There's nothing in here, except for 
some slime on the floor. This is propably where their spawn develop 
into full grown demons. But...What creates them? The exit is to the 
east.

Rooms.Name: Chamber Of Creation
Rooms.Description:
This chamber is...strange. There's a very odd feeling to this room, 
but you can't quite place what it is. There's a small pool in the 
middle of the room, full of what seems to be slime. The pool gives 
away a smell that almost makes you throw up. You see chambers to all 
directions. There's a ladder going up here as well.

Rooms.Name: Spawning room
Rooms.Description:
This is a pretty small room. There's nothing in here, except for
some slime on the floor. This is propably where their spawn develop
into full grown demons. But...What creates them? There's an exit to
the west.

Rooms.Name: Spawning room
Rooms.Description:
This is a pretty small room. There's nothing in here, except for
some slime on the floor. This is propably where their spawn develop
into full grown demons. But...What creates them? The only exit, lies
to the north.

Rooms.Name: Pile Of Garbage
Rooms.Description:
In this chamber there's a pile of garbage. Garbage is everywhere
and the smell is terrible. You see decaying corpses in the pile, 
attracting hundreds of flies. The exit is to the east.

Rooms.Name: Pile Of Garbage
Rooms.Description:
In this chamber there's a pile of garbage. Garbage is everywhere
and the smell is terrible. You see decaying corpses in the pile, 
attracting hundreds of flies. There's an exit to the south.

Rooms.Name: Huge Pile Of Garbage
Rooms.Description:
This chamber is so full of garbage and decaying corpses that you 
hardly fit into it. The smell is absolutely disgusting making you feel 
sick. Around the pile you see a lot of green slime, flowing out to the 
west, which by the way is the only exit.

Rooms.Name: Dimensional trap
Rooms.Description:
This...place is quite abstract. The walls move and shift in color 
constantly, thus making it very hard to concentrate. It seems like 
there's only one way out of here...Down a pitch black hole.

Mobs.Name: demon lord
Mobs.LongDescription: The demon Lord stands here, looking for fresh souls to enslave.
Mobs.Description:
The demon before you, used to be one of the empires greatest gatherer 
of souls and is therefore now a Lord. He is now a commander of the 
soulhunters. He looks almost like a human, but with slightly abnormal 
features.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks at you with the eyes of burning hatred.;
%10 growl

Mobs.Name: demon spawn
Mobs.LongDescription: The spawn of a demon is here, developing into horror.
Mobs.Description:
Something...stands before you. Something, that doesn't seem to be a 
fully developed demon. You can actually see how it grows and shapes 
itself into something evil.

Mobs.Name: demon lord
Mobs.LongDescription: The bony Lord of the dead, is looking out for the living.
Mobs.Description:
The Lord of the dead is the demon in charge of the other side. He 
is the one, who summons the unholy and forces it into the bodies of
the dead. He is a really thin and pale character. No doubt, he still 
holds powerful magic.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote orders a pile of bones to rise.;
%10 emote picks up a femur and begins to chew on it.

Mobs.Name: demon mistress
Mobs.LongDescription: A thin lady-like demon is here, commanding the dead.
Mobs.Description:
The mistress of the dead is the real ruler among the dead. She's the 
one with the real power over death and life. She's very thin, but you 
can see strong and wiry muscles moving beneath her skin. Oh, she's 
almost naked.

Mobs.Name: shadow demon death
Mobs.LongDescription: Shadowy death haunts the darkness.
Mobs.Description:
Death darker than night is the best, and maybe only way to describe 
this demonic being. It is a master assassin among demons, and not many 
are strong enough to stand up to this expert murderer.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%50 emote fades into the dark.

Mobs.Name: demon daemonette
Mobs.LongDescription: Viciously the daemonette stalks towards you.
Mobs.Description:
These...beasts, are extremely fierce and dangerous. They attack all 
living, and not even their own kind are quite safe. They seem to be...
female demons, but you can't be sure. Even the Dethguards avoid the 
daemonettes. Their bloodlust is total.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 kill daemonette;
%15 emote sniffs at the air.

Mobs.Name: demon soulhunter figure
Mobs.LongDescription: A quick figure sneaks around in the shadows.
Mobs.Description:
This, quite small demon, is one of the soulhunters. The soulhunters 
gather souls on their raids among the living. Usually they are all 
dressed in black, and carry black bags. They occasionally sniff at the 
air, trying to find a trail to a fresh soul.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote sniffs at the air.;
%1 yell Isss that a fresssh sssoul I sssmell!?

Mobs.Name: demon lord crimson red man
Mobs.LongDescription: A red magnificent looking beast of a man.
Mobs.Description:
The crimson Lord is a brutal character. He, or whatever it is, is 
all red...bloody red! This is the one that leads the demon armies into 
battle, to command and to conquer...or die trying. Failure doesn't 
exist other than in the minds of the weak.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%90 close gate;
%90 close throne

Mobs.Name: demon warrior guardian
Mobs.LongDescription: A chaotic warrior is on guard here.
Mobs.Description:
This powerful being in front of you, used to be one of the Dethguards. 
It was elevated to the rank of chaos guardian because of long and evil 
service, dedicated to the emperor.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote moves to stand in your way.;
%10 emote assumes the fighting stance of true chaos.

Mobs.Name: demon lord blob
Mobs.LongDescription: A large and extremely repulsive blob.
Mobs.Description:
The Lord of disgust is a truly repulsive being. He is covered with 
dirt, trash and green slime. He drools all the time, and he stinks 
like...no, it is even worse!

Mobs.Name: mistress demon blob
Mobs.LongDescription: A filthy small vibrating blob slithers across the floor.
Mobs.Description:
She's really disgusting, at least you think it is a female. Dirty and 
disgusting, quite repulsive. Smells like a week old corpse. She's 
propably rotting as well...and enjoying it!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote rolls out a huge tongue and catches hundreds of flies.;
%10 burp

Mobs.Name: demon bloodthirster
Mobs.LongDescription: A truly magnificent character, covered by a huge red cloak.
Mobs.Description:
The being in front of you, is one of the most wicked ones in the demon 
Empire. This is the absolute master of utter terror. Stories tell of 
it draining its victims of all blood as well as sanity.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote smiles at you, revealing #Rbloodred#N fangs.;
%10 emote enjoys a drink of blood.

Mobs.Name: guardian demon tormentor
Mobs.LongDescription: A tall, leatherclad daemonette.
Mobs.Description:
The guardian of pain is tall and skinny. She's all dressed in 
tightfitting leather. She would be quite beautiful, if it hadn't been 
for the deep scars in her face. She used to be one of the daemonettes, 
but she was considered to dangerous to her own ranks and was placed 
here as the head tormentor.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote sniffs at the air and turns slowly towards you.;
%10 bash

Mobs.Name: demon reaper murderer
Mobs.LongDescription: A murderer, dressed to spread death and sorrow.
Mobs.Description:
The demonic dark reaper is one bizarre character. All dressed up in 
dark flowing robes, it performs the ancient and most evil of rites, to 
please the Emperor - Living sacrifice!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote performs a sacrifice to the honor of the Emperor.;
%10 emote throws a body into the pit.

Mobs.Name: figure plaguebearer demon
Mobs.LongDescription: A almost tiny spideresque figure, scurries around on the floor.
Mobs.Description:
This, quite small character, is almost completely black except for 
some white lines in its face. As it begins to move, you notice how it 
becomes more and more white, just to become black again. Then you 
understand...it is covered with flies, thousands of black flies.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote chokes on a fly.;
%10 emote orders the flies to bug someone else.

Mobs.Name: Dethguard champion demon guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A large guard with huge muscles is on duty here.
Mobs.Description:
This is the champion of the Dethguards. The winner of their contests, 
of who is to become the Emperor's champion - Their leader!
It has extremely large muscles, and is dressed in what seems to be a 
complete suit of chainmail.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 flex

Mobs.Name: Dethguard demon guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A heavily built guard is on duty here.
Mobs.Description:
One of the fierce and feared Dethguards. These are the Emperor's guard 
of honor. It's quite difficult to imagine a demon with honor. The 
Dethguards are dressed in a complete suit of chainmail which gives 
them at least some protection.

Mobs.Name: demon knight
Mobs.LongDescription: A brightly shining demon is here, leaning on a huge warhammer.
Mobs.Description:
A very big and brightly shining demon. It seems to have quite an armor,
but then you notice that it is naked. It has so bright skin, it looks 
like it is wearing heavy silvery armor.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote lifts up the warhammer, and begins to walk towards you.;
%20 say Puny mortals...

Mobs.Name: warrior avenger
Mobs.LongDescription: A radiant warrior is here looking for his family.
Mobs.Description:
This warrior, is absolutely drenching you with goodness. You feel his 
power and sadeness. His family was captured by the soulhunters, and 
put through an eternity of pain. He went on a lone crusade against the 
demons, trying to find his family. He is still searching and will do 
so until he finds them...or dies.

Mobs.Name: emperor demon
Mobs.LongDescription: The Emperor is here, relaxing in his personal chamber.
Mobs.Description:
The Emperor, the ruler of almost all demons. It's only the Empress 
and her vicious daemonettes who don't do as he orders. He is quite big,
and large red wings can be seen on his back. As he grins, you see sharp
fangs glimmering in the light.

Mobs.Name: demon empress
Mobs.LongDescription: The Empress is here performing evil rites.
Mobs.Description:
The Empress is a very tall and skinny female demon. She used to be 
one of the daemonettes, but was considered to powerful to remain a 
simple daemonette. Power, is all that counts here. She's dressed in 
dark red robes, with magic symbols painted all over it...and herself.

Mobs.Name: wind
Mobs.LongDescription: A strong howling wind haunts these halls.
Mobs.Description:
A wind full of sheer terror. You can't see anything, but you feel a 
very strong presence. You hear terrible cries from all around you, but 
you see nothing...Nothing!

Mobs.Name: wind
Mobs.LongDescription: A strong howling wind haunts these halls.
Mobs.Description:
A wind full of sheer terror. You can't see anything, but you feel a 
very strong presence. You hear terrible cries from all around you, but 
you see nothing...Nothing!

Mobs.Name: demon death darkness
Mobs.LongDescription: Pitch black darkness surrounds you.
Mobs.Description:
Pitch black darkness, that's all there is. Occasionally, you think you 
see a face in all that black. A grim looking face, swirling around in 
that darkness. This is as evil as it possibly can get.

Mobs.Name: morph demon
Mobs.LongDescription: A small demon is here, transforming into something else.
Mobs.Description:
This is a morph demon. They are experts when it comes to disguise 
yourself. Propably because they can change color and shape as they 
want. They are pretty small when they look as they are supposed to.

Mobs.Name: zombie
Mobs.LongDescription: The living dead shambles towards you.
Mobs.Description:
The living dead...zombies...Well, they don't seem to be quite dead 
just yet. Rotting and decaying bodies that live, eh? These are the 
pets of the mistress of the dead.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 bash

Mobs.Name: Cremator demon
Mobs.LongDescription: A really fat demon is here, glowing with heat.
Mobs.Description:
No one really know what the cremator is for. The only known fact, is 
that it really loves fire and heat. The cremator is quite fat, and it 
seems to be naked except for a scorched leather apron.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote sinks a screaming gnome into the lava.

Mobs.Name: demon soulhunter
Mobs.LongDescription: A quick figure sneaks around in the shadows.
Mobs.Description:
This, quite small demon, is one of the soulhunters. The soulhunters 
gather souls on their raids among the living. Usually they are all 
dressed in black, and carry black bags. They occasionally sniff at the 
air, trying to find a trail to a fresh soul.

Mobs.Name: human mchoro mhaeren
Mobs.LongDescription: A grim looking human stands here surrounded by an aura of evil.
Mobs.Description:
The human man before you, might be the only non-demonic being that the
demons respect and maybe even follow. Mchoro Mhaeren made killing and
torture a sport. A hobby to keep him warm in the cold winternights.
He is quite tall and very thin, but you are fairly sure he is as fast
and as deadly as a viper.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grins and says 'Death...is here...';
%10 emote whispers quietly '...destruction from within...'

Mobs.Name: human prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A crazy looking human stands here dressed in torn rags.
Mobs.Description:
The prisoner has gone through quite a lot of beating. His clothes are
torn to shreds, hardly covering him at all. Not that he seems to mind.
Fear and pain has driven him over the cliff of sanity. Now he just
walks around, muttering and whispering words.

Mobs.Name: dying fairy
Mobs.LongDescription: A tiny fairy lies here, barely breathing.
Mobs.Description:
A tiny fairy in extremely bad shape. You feel wrath boiling up within
you as you see that her wings have been...plucked. She's bleeding a lot
and you don't think any healing could help, it has gone to far.
She looks at you with pleading eyes..'Please put me out of this misery'
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote looks at you with tearful eyes.;
%20 sob

Mobs.Name: beaten dwarf
Mobs.LongDescription: A short and very badly beaten dwarf wanders around here.
Mobs.Description:
The dwarf in front of you is very short, even for a dwarf. He is in a
very bad shape, since the demons seem to have been beating him a lot.
His left eye is badly burnt, showing only a black charred hole.
His beard has been burnt as well...actually, it seems like they've 
been roasting him.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grunts weakly.;
%10 emote stumbles on a rock and falls down to his knees.

Mobs.Name: impaled gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: A small impaled gnome has been left to die here.
Mobs.Description:
The gnome in front of you, is wearing a expression telling of extreme
pain and fear. A large stake has been driven through him. It's a
miracle that he still is alive, but it's not a act of goodness to let
him live like this. You wonder if magic is all that is keeping him up?
All just to keep him hurting.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 emote groans loudly as the stake moves.;
%10 emote weeps softly. Tears flow down his cheeks, marring his soul.

Mobs.Name: mutilated elf woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A tall fair skinned woman sits here, trying to regain her strength.
Mobs.Description:
The elven woman seems to be very young. She is bleeding a lot from 
hundreds of scratches, and bruises marks her suffering. She is dying,
but propably welcomes death with open arms. Death is freedom here,
while life, is death!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote whispers to herself.

Mobs.Name: demon lord
Mobs.LongDescription: The demon Lord stands here, looking for fresh souls to enslave.
Mobs.Description:
The demon before you, used to be one of the empires greatest gatherer 
of souls and is therefore now a Lord. He is now a commander of the 
soulhunters. He looks almost like a human, but with slightly abnormal 
features.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote inhales deeply, just to blow foul smelling gas at you.;
%10 growl

Mobs.Name: demon lord
Mobs.LongDescription: The demon Lord stands here, looking for fresh souls to enslave.
Mobs.Description:
The demon before you, used to be one of the empires greatest gatherer 
of souls and is therefore now a Lord. He is now a commander of the 
soulhunters. He looks almost like a human, but with slightly abnormal

Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grins viciously, saliva dropping on the ground, sizzling..;
%10 growl

Mobs.LongDescription: The demon Lord stands here, looking for fresh souls to enslave.
Mobs.Description:
The demon before you, used to be one of the empires greatest gatherer

Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote beckons you to come closer, as bolts arc from eye to eye..;
%10 growl

Objects.Name: ring thorns
Objects.Description: A ring made of thorns.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring, seems to be made of thorns, extremely sharp thorns, pointed
outwards. But still, you notice that if this ring is worn, it will
hurt as the thorns will sink into your flesh.

Objects.Name: fiery blade burning
Objects.Description: A burning blade lights up the area.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sword is burning with a hot, dark red flame, that slowly dances
around the blade. It hurts just to watch the incredibly hot flame, 
while it performs the slow dance of death.

Objects.Name: shreds skin
Objects.Description: Long thin shreds of skin.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This...whip, has several long thin shreds, of what seems to be skin.
Skin torn of the bodies while life still inhabited them. Shreds filled 
with the terror and fear of their victims, as they were flayed.

Objects.Name: crown thorns
Objects.Description: A crown lies here, radiating pain and sorrow.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A crown made for the rulers of the dead, for those who won't mind a 
little pain. It truly is a wicked item, since some of the thorns
surrounding it, are pointed inwards.

Objects.Name: necklace dead chain skull
Objects.Description: A skull hanging from a chain lies here, grinning at you!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The skull from a corpse of a long dead beast, adorns this necklace. 
You can feel the residues of the dark and evil magic, that brought this
necklace to be. As you put it around your neck, you immediately feel
tainted and dirty, but at the same time you feel power, tremendous
power, rushing into you.

Objects.Name: soul believer form
Objects.Description: A shimmering insubstantial form.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You find it hard to believe your eyes, as you gaze upon the shimmering
shape in your hands. Sometimes you see a tiny face, contorted by pain
and anguish. But still it seems to emnate a crazed kind of silent 
worship of the dark.

Objects.Name: staff screams
Objects.Description: A staff covered with gaping mouths lies here screaming at you!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you grab this staff, your ears suddenly get filled with screams of
anguish and despair. It seems like this staff is a...container...of 
souls, with each soul represented by a gaping mouth on the staff.

Objects.Name: dagger shadows
Objects.Description: A dagger that seems to blend into the shadows.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This dagger, which seems to fade into every shadow, was made for the
demonic assassins. It is even difficult to notice, even when you know
it is there.

Objects.Name: spear shadow
Objects.Description: A spear, yearning for the shadows.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you grab this spear, you can't help but notice that all the shadows
around you, seem to be pulled towards you. You can actually...feel the
shadows growing more and more dense.

Objects.Name: cloak shadowy
Objects.Description: A cloak is here, shading the area.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This cloak is the closest thing you can get to a shadow, without 
actually being a shadow. As you put it on, you can't help but notice,
how you seem to fade into the shadows.

Objects.Name: bloodstained chainmail
Objects.Description: A chainmail covered with bloodred spots.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This chainmail, worn by the Daemonettes, has several spots on it, dark
red spots. Propably bloodstains. The Daemonettes were never known of
being tidy.

Objects.Name: whip talons
Objects.Description: A whip with several small talons attached to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A whip, made of somekind of hard...skin, with several small and 
extremely sharp talons attached to it. It is truly an instrument of 
pain, and it seems to have been utilised a lot lately. You can see 
shreds of skin and fur, still hanging from some of the talons.

Objects.Name: mace slaughter
Objects.Description: A mace lies here, crying out for more slaughter.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The two feet long mace before you, seems to call out...no, CRY out for
you to take it and use it. It wants to destroy, annihilate and kill.
You feel uneasy at the thought and touch of the mace.

Objects.Name: chainmail darkred
Objects.Description: A well used darkred chainmail.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The chainmail of the Crimson Lord, darkred as if painted with blood. 
You see small rubys, forming a strange pattern on the back. Either it 
means something, or they've been placed there for extra protection.
However, it doesn't seem to work as it should, since the chainmail is 
pretty damaged. But still it offers great protection.

Objects.Name: boots pointed
Objects.Description: A pair of pointed, darkred boots.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of boots, darkred boots, crafted for the mighty Crimson Lord.
You consider the amount of damage these boots could inflict, and as 
you see that they are pointed, you come to the conclusion: A LOT!

Objects.Name: gauntlets darkred
Objects.Description: A pair of darkred gauntlets with chains dangling from them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The gauntlets of the Crimson Lord, have a dark reddish color. But you
bet that some of that color, actually is blood. They seem to be made 
of some really tough material, but you fail to recognize it. There's a 
lot of chains attached to them, propably to cause more damage. Oh, and 
maybe even enhance the armor.

Objects.Name: darkred skull
Objects.Description: The darkred skull of a long dead beast.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This darkred skull, belonging to the Crimson Lord, was taken from what 
seems to have been a magnificent being. If worn, this might as well 
scare the owners opponets to death. It...looks quite terrifying.

Objects.Name: greaves metallic
Objects.Description: A pair of red metallic greaves.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of greaves from the Crimson Lord lies here, taunting your mind
with its darkred color. These greaves will give excellent protection, 
but they are quite heavy.

Objects.Name: armplates darkred
Objects.Description: A pair of darkred armplates.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The darkred armplates of the Crimson Lord, giving superb protection in
exchange for comfort. They are heavy and big, thus making them 
somewhat clumsy and uncomfortable.

Objects.Name: braids bloody
Objects.ShortDescription: Bloody Braids of a Red Haired Wench
Objects.Description: A pile of bloody hair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a really wicked trophy of the Crimson Lord. The braids of a 
red haired woman, now very bloody. The braids have been tightly 
entwined together, to form a...belt for the wicked. The poor womans,
now quite decayed head, is still dangling from the end of the braids.

Objects.Name: veil insanity cloth jewel
Objects.Description: A pile of cloth with a brightly flashing jewel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The veil of insanity! You shiver at the touch of it, and wonder if the
stories of old tell any truth. The stories of an insane warrior, who 
was bereft of his soul and life. His soul was forced into a headwear 
as a gift for the demon Emperor. Now he rages eternally in it.

Objects.Name: blade crazed
Objects.Description: An oddly shaped blade.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sword with an extremely odd shape to its blade. It is formed 
something like a...spiral! You can imagine the damage this 
weapon can inflict.

Objects.Name: cape repulsive repulsion garment
Objects.Description: An extremely repulsive garment.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look upon this...cape, you feel sick! You feel ready to throw 
up at any time, as a stench strikes at your nostrils. Flies gather 
around this filthy cape.

Objects.Name: femur bone white
Objects.Description: A long white bone, covered with chewing marks.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A long white bone that someone has been chewing on.

Objects.Name: jug blood liquid
Objects.Description: A jug full of a darkred liquid.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large black jug full of what seems to be blood. You try to pour it 
out, but a little later, the jug is full of blood again. This is a 
wicked item. But on the other hand, the bloodthirster is quite a 
bizzare character.

Objects.Name: shield fear blank
Objects.Description: A blank shield, reflecting your most secret fears.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large but surprisingly light shield, made of some kind of highly
polished metal. You can clearly see your own reflection in it, and it
frightens you. You quickly turn away, and immediately you feel your 
courage return.

Objects.Name: burning soul shimmering shape
Objects.Description: A shimmering shape, seems to be burning with a bluish flame.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A shimmering shape, feeding a hot bluish kind of fire with itself. It 
sacrifices itself just to keep the flame burning, but it doesn't seem 
to die. It fades just to come back again, stronger than ever.

Objects.Name: skull mace stick
Objects.Description: A long stick, with a skull attached to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long stick adorned with a large horned skull. You look at the skull
and get a shock as you see a faint glow within. Inside the skull, a 
light seems to have been imprisoned. Or could it be another soul?

Objects.Name: blade unholiness knife
Objects.Description: A well used knife, absolutely drenched with unholiness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sharp and very well used knife. Obviously a very old knife, but 
still it is in a very good condition. Cared for as a child by the 
demonic dark reaper.

Objects.Name: ring runic
Objects.Description: A ring covered with small cuts, filling you with pity and sorrow.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small and very old ring, covered with small, tiny cuts. Several 
hundred of them. You wonder what they are supposed to mean, since 
some of the cuts are newly made, while others are as old as the 
ring itself.

Objects.Name: carving evil signs
Objects.Description: The oldest of signs, meant for the most evil beings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Carved into skin, is the most evil of the ancient signs for the demons.
Glowing with hatred and malice, you feel the strength seep into you. 
Death is a relief, torture...is fun!

Objects.Name: wand madness
Objects.Description: A wand lies here, full of madness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A wand shaped in a wicked way. No matter how much you try, you always 
fail to find the beginning and the end of the wand. As you touch it, 
you feel...crazy! The madness that twisted this artefact, now seeps 
into you.

Objects.Name: ribcage armor
Objects.Description: A huge ribcage from a long dead beast.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A huge disgusting ribcage of a long dead beast. You feel power rushing 
within it, but still you feel reluctant in trying it out. It really is 
a repulsive piece of work.

Objects.Name: orb repulsion
Objects.Description: A dirty and very repulsive orb.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An orb of energy that surrounds you. You feel it push away everyone 
and everything with its disgusting appereance. Flies surround it in
multitudes, and it stinks like...well, it's quite awful. You feel sick.

Objects.Name: badge champion
Objects.Description: A large badge, hanging from a thick gilded chain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large badge, given to the greatest of the dreaded Deth guards. On it 
you can see carved signs saying that the wearer of this badge, is a 
true champion of terror and annihilation. It is hanging from a thick 
gilded chain.

Objects.Name: stone axe
Objects.Description: An axe, made of solid stone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large and very heavy axe, made of some kind of greyish stone. Though 
very blunt, it still is a very formidable weapon. Some runes have been 
hacked into the side of the axe, but time has worn it down.

Objects.Name: warhammer soulsmasher
Objects.Description: A huge two-handed warhammer breaks the silence.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A huge hammer, created for the single purpose of war. To kill the 
living and to torture the dead. You can see some runes carved into the 
long handle, but you fail to decipher them all. But some of them tell 
of souls being contained within the hammer, therefore making it 
possible to strike at the dead as well.

Objects.Name: aura souls shapes
Objects.Description: Several shimmering shapes are here, crying for revenge.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Several shimmering shapes are here, begging for you to avenge their 
deaths. As your heart melts with compassion, you let them cling onto 
you. At once you begin to feel how power, tremendous power, rushes 
into you. You feel stronger than ever.

Objects.Name: claymore sword
Objects.Description: A huge sword, blessed by the Gods.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A huge two-handed sword, glows with a faint light. This sword was 
forged and blessed in ancient times for those who dedicated their 
lives to destroy evil. This is as holy as a weapon possibly could get.

Objects.Name: shield purity
Objects.Description: A shield pulsating with holy wrath.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A shield forged with holy wrath, yearning for you to wear it while 
fighting evil. There are none of the usual signs of an owner, but 
hundreds of tiny runes line the edges. They are to old for you to 
recognize, but you bet they have something to do with fighting evil.

Objects.Name: broken crown remnants
Objects.Description: The remnants of a once magnificent crown.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A crown with its former beauty shattered, but still it manages to show
off a great amount of power...true power. It seems to be made of gold,
but with streaks of red swirling around in it, making it look alive.

Objects.Name: dagger wicked
Objects.Description: A quite ordinary looking dagger, with a wicked touch to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you grab this quite ordinary looking dagger, you feel filthy and 
tainted. You feel as if something has been forced upon you, but you 
can't tell what.

Objects.Name: bag souls black
Objects.Description: A pitch black bag, filled with movement and screams.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bag, darker than the night, made of soft velvet cloth with inlaid
strands of gold and silver placed in intricate patterns. You can feel
through the cloth, something pushing, trying to get out. As you open
the bag you feel...a power, surging beside and through you, escaping
the bag.

Objects.Name: sceptre crystal
Objects.Description: A large sceptre, topped with a perfect crystal skull.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sceptre, used by the demonic emperors since the beginning of time.
The maybe three feet long sceptre is topped with a skull, perfectly
cut from the clearest of crystals. Within the skull, light has been
trapped, thus making it glow softly.

Objects.Name: belt skulls
Objects.Description: Several skulls, fastened to a belt made of hair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A belt with several skulls dangling from what seems to be braids. The
skulls are all from different races. You feel the taint of this evil
artefact as you touch it. Powerful and foul magic has been worked here
by the most powerful of magicians.

Objects.Name: bowl souls
Objects.Description: A small bowl filled with the wailing cries of the captured souls.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small black bowl with figures of pain and despair painted on it with 
a sharp red color. The color stings your eyes...You look into the bowl 
and see movement. But that is all there is. Movement.

Objects.Name: witchblade blade
Objects.Description: A short blade, glowing with a bright blue color.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This shortbladed sword is emnating a bright hot blue glow. As you try 
it out, the sword seems to meld with your arm. Becoming a lethal 
extension of it.

Objects.Name: axe longshafted
Objects.Description: A longshafted axe reflects the last fading rays of sunlight.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A highly polished and very heavy axe rests comfortably in your hands. 
You feel an urge to kill. You feel yourself being swept away and you 
struggle furiously to regain control of yourself.

Objects.Name: book necronomicon
Objects.Description: A book with a vicious looking face carved into it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Necronomicon, the book of the dead! You tremble at the touch of the 
human skin used as cover. This book is one of the most wanted magical 
artefacts. The carved face on the cover is distorted with pain, 
looking like it is being torn between two worlds. Suddenly the eyes 
pop open...

Objects.Name: souls vial living
Objects.Description: A small vial filled with a greyish mist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small vial made of clear glass. You doubt you could break this vial, 
no matter how hard your efforts would be. Inside the vial you see a 
greyish mist swirling around in intricate patterns.

Objects.Name: cloak velvet red
Objects.Description: A pile of soft red velvet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large red cloak, made of a very soft and smooth velvet garment. It 
has a strange kind of glow, and as it catches the wind it seems to 
expand.

Objects.Name: jar agony
Objects.Description: A large jar, filled with sounds of crying.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A large black jar, filled with pain and suffering. A wicked...trophy!

Objects.Name: fountain
Objects.Description: A fountain filled with a thick red fluid.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The fountain is quite big, and it seems to be made of white marble 
that now is rather red. Stories mention that this fountain not only 
hold blood, but also the last thoughts of the victims that the mighty 
Bloodthirster has killed.

Objects.Name: nightbringer trident
Objects.Description: A black trident yearns for the night.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a legendary weapon. It's said that the night was captured 
and forced into three magical artefacts. But that can't be quite right,
since night still exists, or..? The trident is pitch black, and is 
maybe three feet long.

Objects.Name: lashes strands
Objects.Description: Pitch black strands of darkness lie curled up in a neat pile.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a legendary weapon. It's said that the night was captured
and forced into three magical artefacts. But that can't be quite right,
since night still exists, or..? It looks like a whip...but it 
certainly looks odd, as the whip disappears occasionally into the 
night, just to come back for more destruction.

Objects.Name: shroud
Objects.Description: A shroud of utter black swirls around here, disturbing your view.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Nightshroud! A legendary piece of armor. It's said that the night was
captured and forced into three magical artefacts. But that can't be
quite right, since night still exists, or..? The shroud is dark, very
dark, as extremely thick darkness engulfs this item.

Objects.Name: vial magma
Objects.Description: A vial full with a hot red fluid.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small vial full of what seems to be magma. At least it is hot, very
hot, and it does light up the room somewhat. The vial seems to be made
of white marble, but you bet magic has enhanced it.

Objects.Name: mirror key
Objects.Description: A small mirror reflects your thoughts.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small, almost tiny mirror. It has quite an odd shape to it, since it
vaguely resembles a key. The mirror seems strange. It sort of,
reflects your image in a strange way. Everything looks too clear.

Objects.Name: cracked mirror key
Objects.Description: A small, cracked mirror.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small, broken mirror. A large crack runs straight through it. That's
odd, it resembles a key. Who would make a key out of a mirror?

Objects.Name: key claw
Objects.Description: A large oddly shaped claw.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large claw that someone has been carving on. It is shaped like a key,
thus making it look pretty grotesque.

Objects.Name: bag diamonds
Objects.Description: A large bag full of glittering stones.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large black bag, full of what seems to be diamonds. This must be
worth a lot.

Objects.Name: chest gold
Objects.Description: A chest full of golden bars.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large and very heavy chest, full of golden bars. Gold!? This must be
worth a lot.

Objects.Name: skeleton
Objects.Description: A skeleton of a long dead minotaur.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A skeleton of a long dead minotaur, judging by the size and the 
remaining horns.

Objects.Name: skeleton
Objects.Description: A short skeleton, with very thick bones.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A short skeleton. Dwarven bones judging by the thickness and the 
height.

Objects.Name: skull
Objects.Description: A skull that someone has crushed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The skull of someone who died of a hard blow to the head.

Objects.Name: corpse
Objects.Description: The corpse of a fairy lies here, covered with flies.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The decaying corpse of a small fairy has been left to rot.

Objects.Name: corpse
Objects.Description: The remains of a small gnome child is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A small gnome child, or at least you think it is...was a gnome.

Objects.Name: pile ashes
Objects.Description: A smoking pile of ashes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large pile of still smoldering ashes. Seems like the demons had a 
barbeque here, since you see a couple of hands and feet still lying in
the pile...unharmed.

Objects.Name: wood piece shield
Objects.Description: A large piece of thick wood lies here, slightly resembling a shield.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large piece of a tree trunk. Thick and very heavy. A few straps have
been attached to it so that you can strap it to your arm...as a shield!

Objects.Name: wooden buckler
Objects.Description: A small buckler, seemingly made out of wood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small round buckler, made of what seems to be oak. Hard and sturdy.
It is so small, it must take quite a vain charcter to use one of these.
Or an expert in battle.

Objects.Name: sphere soulsphere
Objects.Description: A large sphere, pulsating with life.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the soulsphere of someone. The vessel into which the soul
flees upon death. You can feel power surging...racing through it.
Raging towards the boundaries that is holding it in.

Objects.Name: face pile skin
Objects.ShortDescription: Torn off Face of a Man
Objects.Description: A pile of skin.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The torn of face of a man glares at you with hollow eyes. A terrible
object meant to spread fear and hatred. A toy for the wicked!

Objects.Name: fairy wings
Objects.Description: A pair of small almost translucent wings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small pair of wings, 'plucked' from a fairy. It is hard to see them,
since they are almost translucent, and very small.
